reason: I have already paid somebody $1,500 a month for a year to tell me about clicks instead of jobs, so a free hour and a one-page write-up does not get me back in that chair. If the fix is real, tell me the fix and the price in the email and skip the meeting.
objection: An hour of my time is the most expensive thing on that page, and the last guy who wanted to look at how my business handles inquiries was building a retainer. I cannot tell from this whether you are a handyman who fixes one thing or a consultant who comes back every month.
would_change_my_mind: A one-page sample of what you would actually write up for a business like mine, with the price and the finish line on it, sent to my phone - no meeting first. And someone in McHenry or Winnebago County whose quote-to-job time actually dropped who will take my call.
